kind: original-kernel protocol inspection and partial simulated implementation
provenance: Same decoded original 18A5351d research kernel as unlock-authorization-inspection.json; original binaries and disassembly remain outside Git.

actual_trigger.observed: One authorized original MKBUnlockDevice(NULL,NULL) call returned -1; kernel selector9 returned e00002bc, with simulator Unknown(0x18) between queries.
actual_trigger.original_default: Unimplemented opcode echoed request as response without rebuilding its response hash.
actual_trigger.causal_inspection: Opcode18 response decoder expects20 body bytes but null-secret request has32. It requires complete consumption; mismatch returns -1, which err_sks_to_aks maps to e00002bc. No passcode-rejection inference.

opcode_18_request_body.handling: preserved by protocol header; not interpreted as Apple identity

wire.opcode_04_query: selector0, owner:uint64, handle:uint32=0, desired_state:int32=-1, secret_blob_length:uint32=0; response selector0,state:uint32,action_flags:uint64=0
wire.opcode_19_query: selector0, owner:uint64, handle:uint32=0, query_options:uint32=1; response selector0,DER_length:uint32,DER bytes
wire.der_subset: SET { SEQUENCE { UTF8String "ss", INTEGER state } }; all unspecified fields absent. In particular no guessed sls enum.
wire.error_transport: Mailbox byte3 is signed8 status, no DMA response on error. -11 is bad argument; -1 generic unsupported. No secret bytes logged.

state_model.scope: Only INFERNO_SIMULATED_SEP builds; existing upstream simulation is an unencrypted placeholder, not production SEP security.
state_model.transition: Only structurally valid system-handle0 operation0 options0 empty-secret requests with enough output capacity change unlocked_since_boot to true.
state_model.queries: Both scalar0x04 and DER0x19 report bit22 plus bit2 only when the accepted transition occurred. Neither query changes state.

proven_bits.2: MKBDeviceUnlockedSinceBoot at0x7d40 extracts this bit; original Security canPersistMetrics at0x1a96c corroborates.
proven_bits.22: Original MKB KBisxARTBasedKeyBag at0x6d8c-0x6d90 extracts this bit.

state_model.unmodeled: No guessed locked/unlocked bits, sls enum, passcode verification, timers, key extraction, Apple authentication, notification injection or security-policy bypass. Unknown fields are absent; original decoder defaults absent fields to zero, which must not be labeled unlocked.
state_model.other_opcode_04_operations: Structurally validated, then retain upstream behavior unless system0 query-1.

action_flags.0: Arms lock timer using second output as absolute IPC-usec deadline.
action_flags.implementation: All action flags/deadline zero; no fabricated notifications.

options_limit: Owned NULL-options client defaults to type5; unlock computes options0 unless type2. Original device_opts_adjust_for_metal_smasher may additionally setbit3 depending on battery-policy state. Boot8 did not capture raw wire options; implementation accepts only0 and logs/rejects any adjustment.

validation.result: PASS: before/after state, exact reply lengths, DER ss, unsupported options/secret, short buffers and output-capacity rejection
validation.not_guest_evidence: Original API result, first-unlock, migration progress, full build and boot remain required follow-up checks.
